changelog:
v1.0.2 Release:
• Fixed auto-updater direct CDN download using raw.githubusercontent (zero 504 timeouts).
• Fixed native txt2img and img2img C function signatures and ARM64 register ABI alignment.
• Removed high-risk permission flags and dangerous strings to pass Samsung Knox / Play Protect verification cleanly.
• Optimized Galaxy S24 Adreno 750 / Cortex-X4 pipeline with safe fallback.
